chunks: 5613 - That which Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a woman who died and left her husband, he عليه السلام said: “So all the wealth belongs to him.” I said: “A man dies and leaves his wife?” He عليه السلام said: “The wealth belongs to her.”

key_terms.زَوْجَهَا: her husband, the surviving spouse in the case mentioned
key_terms.فَالْمَالُ كُلُّهُ لَهُ: all the property belongs to him

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about inheritance between a husband and wife?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about inheritance between spouses in the case described. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that when one spouse dies and the other remains, the estate in this report belongs to the surviving spouse.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5613 - Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Aban ibn Uthman from Abu Basir who reported from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)

regarding a woman who passed away and left behind her husband.
Imam (as) said: "All the wealth belongs to him."
I asked: "What if a man dies and leaves behind his wife?"
Imam (as) replied: "The wealth belongs to her."
